description: React component for a modal displaying team member progress, including resource rendering, progress fetching, and user interactions.

methods.name: getMemberProgress
methods.description: Fetches progress data for a team member on a specific resource.

methods.name: renderResource
methods.description: Renders the resource diagram (SVG) based on resource metadata and renderer type.
